_definitions.full_grid: Design A grid N = 5, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 100, 200 (pre-specified points plus the five points added by addendum 1); the printed crossings
_definitions.frozen_grid: the pre-specified grid N = 5, 10, 20, 50, 100, 200 (analysis plan section 3); same curves and crossing rule, the five added points ignored
_definitions.ci_all_draws: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles over all 1,000 joint student bootstrap draws (seed [42, 77, sid]); a draw that never reaches the level within 200 is ranked above 200; 'inf' = above 200
_definitions.share_draws_reaching: share of the 1,000 bootstrap draws whose curve reaches the level within 200
_definitions.criterion_b: S2 replication criterion (b): minimum N for .70 above the S2 median of 31 rated answers for at least three of bias, Brier, gamma and AUROC
_definitions.alpha_minus_icc1_k: per-quiz coefficient alpha minus the one-way ICC(1,k) (items nested in students), median and range over the 14 quizzes; deterministic, no Monte Carlo error
_definitions.phi_minus_icc1_k: per-quiz G-theory absolute coefficient Phi minus ICC(1,k); deterministic
_definitions.x_minus_sb_median_over_reruns: median over the 14 quizzes of (alpha or Phi) minus the 50-split per-student split-half mean, recomputed on K = 200 fresh split seeds [42, 505, 2, QuizId, k]; mean, SD and percentiles over the K reruns
_definitions.students_entering_resolution_curves: share of Design A students with both halves defined (mean over the 50 random splits), i.e. the students whose half-scores enter the gamma or AUROC correlation at that N
_definitions.auroc_minus_gamma: Design A random-half reliability of AUROC minus that of gamma, at N <= 50

students_entering_resolution_curves.definition: share of Design A students with both halves defined, mean over the 50 random splits; sb_corr_cols drops a student when either half is undefined
